concerns.text: The specification (FR‑017) and success criterion SC‑012 require computing lag‑1 autocorrelation on the final i.i.d. point‑estimate dataset and enforcing |ρ₁| < 0.1. No task in the list implements this check, so the acceptance criterion is dropped.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – no synthetic fallback for US‑1b
concerns.text: User Story 1b permits generating a synthetic catalog if official IllustrisTNG/EAGLE releases are unavailable. The plan (and tasks) state the pipeline aborts in that case, violating the story’s acceptance criteria and silently narrowing the allowed behavior.
